parts.text: Analyze the sample outage logs, classify events by severity (CRITICAL, WARNING, INFO), and generate an SRE incident report.
The incident report highlights CRITICAL errors including CloudSQL connection pool exhaustion and OOMKilled container events, along with recommended remediation steps.
Parse and classify this raw GCP log entry: {"severity": "ERROR", "httpRequest": {"status": 503}, "textPayload": "HTTP 503 Service Unavailable"}
Classified severity: CRITICAL (HTTP Status 503 Service Unavailable).
